question: Which of the following is NOT a feature of succulent plants?
solution:
The correct answer is __**No leaves**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Succulent plants, often known as succulents,** are a type of plant that thrives in dry environments and has some sections that are** thick and fleshy in order to store and retain water.**
 
• **The Latin word sucus, **which means sap or juice, is where the word "succulent" first appeared.
 
• Succulent plants are distinguished by their capacity to store water in many plant components, including the stem and leaves.
 
• On occasion, the name also refers to plants that store water in their roots, such as geophytes, which have a unique adaption to keep herbivores away from the plant.
 
• The term "succulent" in horticulture occasionally refers to plants other than cacti, which a botanist would consider to be succulents. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Succulent plants** frequently endure drought and develop abnormally thick leaves, stems, or roots because they store water in their tissues.
 
• Xerophytes are plants that can survive in severe, arid settings; examples include succulents.
